name: worktrees
description: Your repository's git worktrees in a band above the prompt (/worktrees): branch, folder and a short Haiku summary of each, with open here, copy path and delete.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: The model that writes each worktree's short summary from its commits and changes. An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id.

showSummaries.title: Show summaries
showSummaries.description: Ask the summary model for a 4-10 word summary of each worktree's branch. Off, no model calls are made.
